lines.speaker: Dockson
lines.text: The Canton of Resource keeps its real ledgers under the obligators' own roof — tithe counts, army requisitions, every noble house's leverage. Get us those pages and we know exactly how much steel the Lord Ruler can actually field.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: There's at least one Seeker posted at night. Bronze-burner — he won't see you in the dark, but he'll feel you burning anything at all unless you're wrapped in copper.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: And if a guard spots me anyway?

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: One guard, you can handle quietly. Raise the whole canton and we're done for the night — pull out before that happens.
